title: DP810 Exchange Rate Regimes and Trade Prices: Does the EMS Matter?
title_zh: DP810 汇率制度与贸易价格：欧洲货币体系是否重要？
authors: Andre Sapir, Khalid Sekkat, Andre Sapir; Khalid Sekkat
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the role of the exchange rate regime in the process of trade adjustment, by examining the relationship between trade prices and exchange rate regimes. The theoretical framework is a dynamic one à la Froot-Klemperer (1989). The empirical investigation takes advantage of the simultaneous occurrence, since 1979, of relatively stable exchange rates inside the ERM and instable rates outside to engage in a controlled experiment on the impact of the exchange rate regime on trade prices. The results suggest that a system of pegged rates like the EMS, although helpful, is not necessary to achieve a smooth process of trade adjustment. It appears that the absence of misalignment rather than the type of exchange rate regime is the crucial factor for fulfilling such an objective.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察贸易价格与汇率制度之间的关系，探究汇率制度在贸易调整过程中的作用。理论框架采用Froot-Klemperer（1989）的动态模型。实证研究利用1979年以来欧洲汇率机制（ERM）内部汇率相对稳定而外部汇率不稳定的同期现象，开展关于汇率制度对贸易价格影响的受控实验。结果表明，尽管欧洲货币体系（EMS）等钉住汇率制度有所助益，但并非实现平稳贸易调整过程的必要条件。实现该目标的关键因素似乎在于避免汇率失调，而非汇率制度类型本身。

title: Payday and the Monthly Attention Cycle of Low-Wage Workers
title_zh: DP21775 发薪日与低薪工人的月度注意力周期
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using linked survey and administrative wage records, we measure workers’ financial monitoring through the accuracy of their self-reported earnings. An unsupervised latent-class model distinguishes transitory reporting errors from rounding behavior and persistent reporting biases, allowing us to interpret lower reporting uncertainty as more precise knowledge of one’s wages. Among low-wage workers, reporting precision exhibits a pronounced pay-cycle pattern: it increases by approximately 12 percent in the days leading up to payday and declines immediately afterward. No comparable pattern emerges among higher-wage workers. These findings suggest that predictable liquidity constraints lead low-wage workers to monitor their personal finances more closely as payday approaches.
abstract_zh: 利用关联的调查数据与行政工资记录，我们通过工人自报收入的准确性来衡量其财务监控程度。采用无监督潜类别模型，将暂时性报告误差与四舍五入行为及持续性报告偏差区分开来，从而将较低的报告不确定性解释为对自身工资更精确的认知。在低收入工人群体中，报告精确性呈现出显著的薪酬周期模式：发薪日前数天精确性提升约12%，发薪日后立即下降。而高收入工人中未发现类似模式。这些发现表明，可预测的流动性约束导致低收入工人在发薪日临近时更密切地监控个人财务状况。

title: DP145 From Labour History to the History of Industrial Relations
title_zh: DP145 从劳工史到劳资关系史
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article advances a new conception of labour history as the history of industrial relations, understood broadly as the changing relationships between workers, trade unions, employers and the state. The first half of the paper examines the major interpretative traditions in British labour history, from the Webbs and the 'Oxford School' to the postwar social historians and the 'rank-and-filists'. It shows that despite their many differences, both institutionalists and social historians explain the development of labour institutions by reference to the objective interests of social groups, and goes on to raise some theoretical objections to this form of explanation. The second half of the paper draws on the findings of recent research on the history of work and industrial relations in late nineteenth and twentieth century Britain to argue that relationships between workers and employers were shaped less by informal groups or spontaneous social and economical processes than by institutional forces: by organizations such as trade unions, shop stewards' committees, business enterprises, employers' associations and the state; and by the rules and procedures governing their interaction such as collective agreements, conciliation and arbitration boards, wages councils and legislati.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的劳工史概念，即将其视为劳资关系史，广义上理解为工人、工会、雇主与国家之间不断变化的关系。论文前半部分考察了英国劳工史的主要阐释传统，从韦伯夫妇与“牛津学派”到战后社会史学家及“基层活动派”。研究表明，尽管制度主义者与社会史学家存在诸多差异，但两者均通过参照社会群体的客观利益来解释劳工制度的发展，并进而对这种解释模式提出若干理论质疑。论文后半部分借鉴近期关于19世纪末至20世纪英国工作与劳资关系史的研究成果，论证工人与雇主之间的关系更多受到制度力量而非非正式群体或自发社会经济进程的影响：这些制度力量包括工会、车间代表委员会、企业、雇主协会及国家等组织，以及集体协议、调解与仲裁委员会、工资委员会及立法等规范其互动的规则与程序。

title: After Credit Suisse, markets find bail-in less credible
title_zh: 瑞信事件后，市场对内部纾困机制的信任度下降
authors: Alessandro Di Stefano, Yvan Lengwiler, Kumar Rishabh
abstract: When Credit Suisse failed in March 2023, Swiss authorities, against market expectations, set aside the resolution plan and arranged a UBS takeover backed by public guarantees, sparing the bail-in bondholders who were next in line to absorb losses. This column traces how that choice reshaped investor beliefs about bail-in across Europe. Spreads on bail-in debt narrowed, the funding penalty on weaker banks shrank, and yields moved less on earnings news. Each points the same way: investors now see bail-in as less likely, a sign that its credibility has declined.
abstract_zh: 2023年3月瑞信倒闭时，瑞士当局违背市场预期，搁置处置计划并安排瑞银在公共担保支持下进行收购，使本应承担损失的保释债持有人得以幸免。本专栏追踪了这一选择如何重塑欧洲投资者对保释机制的信念。保释债利差收窄，弱势银行的融资惩罚缩小，收益率对盈利消息的反应减弱。这些现象均指向同一结论：投资者如今认为保释可能性降低，表明其可信度已然下降。

title: Employment Stability, Earnings Dynamics, and Life-Cycle Savings
title_zh: 就业稳定性、收入动态与生命周期储蓄
authors: Moritz Kuhn, Leanne Nam, Gasper Ploj
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Labor markets feature large heterogeneity in employment stability: some careers provide lifetime employment, while others involve frequent transitions in and out of work. While this heterogeneity shapes earnings dynamics and labor market risk, its implications for household saving behavior remain poorly understood. We document two new empirical facts. More stable careers (i) exhibit steeper life-cycle earnings growth and (ii) accumulate significantly more wealth per dollar of income, even within narrowly defined worker groups. To interpret these facts, we develop a life-cycle search-and-saving model with heterogeneous employment stability, job-to-job mobility, endogenous human capital accumulation, and incomplete markets. The model matches both life-cycle earnings and wealth dynamics across careers. Our central finding is that heterogeneity in employment stability reshapes the nature of saving. Stable careers generate sustained earnings growth with a focus on life-cycle saving, while unstable careers are characterized by precautionary, buffer-stock behavior that limits long-run wealth accumulation. Quantitatively, differential earnings growth accounts for about 60% of the wealth gap across careers. These microeconomic differences have important macroeconomic implications. We demonstrate that heterogeneity in employment stability amplifies wealth inequality and substantially increases the macroeconomic consumption response to unemployment shocks.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场在就业稳定性方面存在显著异质性：部分职业提供终身雇佣保障，而另一些职业则频繁经历就业与失业的转换。尽管这种异质性塑造了收入动态与劳动力市场风险，但其对家庭储蓄行为的影响仍鲜有研究。我们揭示了两项新的实证事实：稳定性较高的职业（i）具有更陡峭的生命周期收入增长曲线，且（ii）即使在严格定义的工人群体内部，每单位收入积累的财富也显著更多。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含异质性就业稳定性、岗位间流动、内生人力资本积累及不完全市场的生命周期搜寻-储蓄模型。该模型能够匹配不同职业的生命周期收入与财富动态。核心发现是：就业稳定性异质性重塑了储蓄的本质。稳定职业产生持续的收入增长，聚焦于生命周期储蓄；而不稳定职业则呈现预防性缓冲库存行为，限制了长期财富积累。量化分析表明，收入增长差异解释了约60%的职业间财富差距。这些微观差异具有重要的宏观经济含义：我们证明就业稳定性异质性会加剧财富不平等，并显著放大宏观经济对失业冲击的消费响应。

title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years
title_zh: 美国增加避孕药具的经济可及性是否能减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES两年随机对照试验的证据
authors: Martha J. Bailey, Emilia Brito, Deniz Gorgulu, Kelsey Figone, Vanessa Wanner Lang, Alexa Prettyman, Vanessa K. Dalton
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission in Sub-Saharan Africa: Evidence from Emerging and Frontier Markets
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的货币政策传导：来自新兴与前沿市场的证据
authors: Johanna Tiedemann & Olivier Bizimana & Kiswendsida Tougouma
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper empirically reassesses monetary policy transmission in emerging and frontier market economies in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA EFMs). Using the identification approach of Romer and Romer (2004), we construct measures of monetary policy shocks and provide evidence on transmission mechanisms in the region. We show that monetary policy shocks pass through quickly to short-term market interest rates and lead to persistent increases in bank deposit and lending rates in most economies, indicating an operative bank-based interest rate channel. By contrast, exchange rates generally do not appreciate and, in many cases, depreciate following monetary tightening, consistent with the exchange rate puzzle—suggesting that interest rate hikes alone may be insufficient to systematically influence exchange rate movements. We also find that contractionary monetary policy reduces both output and inflation, with effects that are modest and notably weaker than in more developed economies. In addition, we find that transmission is stronger in economies that have adopted, or are transitioning toward, inflation-targeting regimes. Finally, we show that cross-country heterogeneity in transmission largely reflects differences in monetary policy transparency, financial development, and, to a lesser extent, fiscal dominance.
abstract_zh: 本文对撒哈拉以南非洲新兴及前沿市场经济体（SSA EFMs）的货币政策传导机制进行了实证再评估。采用Romer与Romer（2004）的识别方法，我们构建了货币政策冲击的度量指标，并提供了该区域传导机制的证据。研究表明，货币政策冲击能迅速传导至短期市场利率，并在多数经济体中导致银行存款利率与贷款利率持续上升，表明银行主导的利率渠道具有有效性。相比之下，汇率在货币紧缩后通常不会升值，反而在多数情况下出现贬值，这与"汇率之谜"现象一致——暗示单纯加息可能不足以系统性影响汇率变动。我们还发现，紧缩性货币政策会同时降低产出与通胀，但其影响幅度温和且显著弱于发达经济体。此外，在已采用或正转向通胀目标制的经济体中，货币政策传导效应更强。最后，研究表明跨国传导异质性主要源于货币政策透明度、金融发展水平的差异，而财政主导地位的影响相对较小。

title: Political Accountability and Local Government Debt: Evidence from China
title_zh: 政治问责与地方政府债务：来自中国的证据
authors: Li, Runheng, Tang, Yao, Weng, Xi, Zhou, Li-An
official: 官方在线 2026-04-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study investigates how the interaction of political accountability and local officials' career incentives shapes the market for Municipal Corporate Bonds (MCBs) in China, taking the 2017 local government debt personal responsibility rule as a quasi-natural experiment. We develop a stylized incomplete-information bargaining model to analyze how the rule reshapes the bargaining equilibrium by rendering officials' observable characteristics credible signals of bailout incentives. Using a dataset of prefecture-level MCBs from 2008 to 2020, we empirically test the model's predictions and focus on separating officials' incentive effects from their inherent ability. Our core findings show that post-announcement of the rule, each additional year of a local party secretary's remaining time to retirement, a proxy for bailout incentives, reduces MCB spreads by approximately 2.5 basis points and increases issuance volume by about 2.0%. These effects are significantly amplified in fiscally stressed cities. Notably, under the 2017 rule, cities led by party secretaries with stronger bailout incentives can expand MCB issuance, which is contrary to the rule's original intent to rein in local borrowing.
abstract_zh: 本研究以2017年地方政府债务终身问责制为准自然实验，探究政治问责与地方官员职业激励的交互作用如何塑造中国市政企业债券市场。我们构建了一个简约的不完全信息讨价还价模型，分析该制度如何通过使官员可观测特征成为纾困激励的可信信号，重塑讨价还价均衡。基于2008-2020年地级市市政企业债券数据集，我们实证检验模型预测，并重点分离官员激励效应与内在能力差异。核心发现表明：该制度实施后，地方党委书记退休剩余年限（纾困激励代理变量）每增加一年，市政企业债券利差下降约2.5个基点，发行规模增长约2.0%。上述效应在财政压力较大的城市显著增强。值得注意的是，在2017年问责制下，由纾困激励更强的党委书记领导的城市反而能够扩大市政企业债券发行规模，这与该制度抑制地方举债的初始意图相悖。
